Hi,

  no update as promised in march on the kickstarter page, no new information nor update, even the link on the site go up to the same effing temporary placeholder from before the project launch.

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
I'm guessing its because GtG is composed of a very small team that usually works late hours designing and testing.  As a playtester, I can tell you that they worked like mad things on GSF, and then started immediately working like mad things on tactics.

I can get the frustration, and I'm not trying to dismiss what you are saying.  But they are really working hard, and I can tell you first hand that they care very much about it.
